The Kentucky Open Records Act Procedures for The City of Campbellsville The City of Campbellsville in compliance with the Open Records Act, K RS 61.870 - 61.884 hereby establishes guidelines for the procedures to be followed in the request of public records, whether stored in a computer or on paper.
